verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique, attorney-led immigration law firm offering visa and green-card legal services, not a software platform. Official SDKs are a category error for this kind of professional-services product. The probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, and nothing in the evidence suggests the firm ships any developer tooling that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
